# Wayland declarations and protocol metadata

Wayland 1.26.0 headers and protocol metadata, xdg-shell from wayland-protocols
1.49, obtained from the official Fedora development packages. Exact package
versions are recorded in `protocols/versions.txt`.

`wayland-protocol.c` and the xdg-shell, fractional-scale-v1 and viewporter twins were generated by
`wayland-scanner 1.26.0` from the included XML sources. Preserve their generated
content and license notices. The original headers, XML and generated files
carry MIT-style license notices in full.

Upstream: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wayland/wayland and
https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wayland/wayland-protocols.

The cursor-shape-v1, tablet-v2 (protocol type dependency) and text-input-unstable-v3
XML/header/private-code files were generated from the same official
wayland-protocols-devel 1.49 package with wayland-scanner 1.26.0. wayland-cursor.h
is the unmodified header from wayland-devel 1.26.0. Preserve all license notices.

Only declarations and protocol metadata are bundled. Native window code
dynamically loads the system `libwayland-client.so.0` and uses array marshalling.
